stem: A nurse identifies an ethical dilemma involving a client's care. Which action is consistent with the 2026 NCLEX-RN Management of Care blueprint?

options.A: Recognize and report the ethical dilemma through the appropriate organizational process
options.B: Limit the concern to informal discussion with coworkers and do not report it
options.C: Ignore the dilemma unless the client experiences physical harm
options.D: Document that an ethical concern exists but take no action to communicate it

rationale: The 2026 NCSBN Test Plan explicitly includes recognizing and reporting ethical dilemmas within Management of Care. It also includes informing clients and staff members of ethical issues affecting care and practicing consistently with the nurses' code of ethics. Therefore A is the best answer. B, C, and D all fail to carry out the required reporting function.
educational_objective: When an ethical dilemma affecting client care is identified, recognize and report it through the appropriate organizational process rather than leaving it unaddressed or only discussing it informally.
source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
source_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11: 'Recognize and report ethical dilemmas'; Appendix A, printed p.21 / PDF p.25, 'Ethical Practice': recognize and report ethical dilemmas, inform client and staff of ethical issues affecting care, practice consistently with the nurses' code of ethics
source_claim_supported: The RN is expected to recognize and report ethical dilemmas affecting client care.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11 and Appendix A printed p.21 / PDF p.25 — Ethical Practice
correction_summary: Removed the unsupported universal claim that any nurse can directly request an ethics committee consultation under 'most facility policies.' Access routes and committee procedures are organization-specific. Rebuilt the item around the exact NCSBN 2026 requirement to recognize and report ethical dilemmas, without inventing a universal consultation pathway.
audit_findings: A directly matches NCSBN's activity statement. B, C, and D all omit reporting or delay action without support. The corrected item does not assume a specific facility's ethics-consultation access rules. No second answer, cueing, unsupported precision, or unresolved conflict remains.
